definition: Just beginning and not yet fully formed or organized.
example: An inchoate sense of unease gradually became a specific concern.
nuance: Inchoate emphasizes lack of formation, not merely novelty.
options: Her inchoate proposal contained a promising instinct but no clear plan yet.
Her inchoate proposal was complete and fully polished.
Inchoate meant that the project was finished years ago.
The proposal was inchoate because its final design was precise.
reasons: An emerging but unformed proposal is inchoate.
A fully formed proposal is no longer inchoate.
A precise final design is developed rather than unformed.
